---
title: "03 · Confirmatory Factor Analysis"
---

## Specifying the model in Mplus

We confirm the two-factor structure suggested by the EFA, allowing the two factors to correlate.

```
TITLE: Two-factor CFA of personality items;
DATA: FILE = "items.dat";
VARIABLE: NAMES = y1-y8;
MODEL:
  eta1 BY y1-y4;
  eta2 BY y5-y8;
OUTPUT: STANDARDIZED MODINDICES;
```

```
CFI/TLI            0.974 / 0.963
RMSEA (90% CI)      0.041 (0.028, 0.053)
SRMR                0.032
Correlation ETA1 WITH ETA2   0.512
```

::: {.callout-tip}
Check modification indices before freeing any cross-loading — a large MI is a symptom, not automatically a justified respecification.
:::
